name: Trend Micro - Deep Security - Intrusion Prevention System
description: Trend Micro - Deep Security - Intrusion Prevention System visualizes the last 24 hours of intrusion prevention events and offers insights into top source IPs, hosts preventing IPS events, and reasons behind detected IPS events through concise timeline and table charts.
title: Trend Micro - Deep Security - Intrusion Prevention System

panels.title: Top 5 Reasons For Prevented IPS Events

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  dst
| extract "CEF:\s*0\|(?<Device_Vendor>.*)\|(?<Device_Product>.*)\|(?<Device_Version>.*)\|(?<Signature_ID>.*)\|(?<Name>.*)\|(?<Severity>.*)\|(?<Extension>.*)" 
| where (signature_id >= 200 AND signature_id <= 299) OR (signature_id >= 300 AND signature_id <= 399) OR (signature_id >= 500 AND signature_id <= 899) OR signature_id = 10 OR (signature_id >= 1000000 AND signature_id <= 1999999) 
| "Intrusion Prevention" as deepsecuritysource 
| parse regex field=extension "act=(?<Action>.+?)\s\w+?=" nodrop 
| if(action matches "IDS:*","Detect","Prevent") as action
| where action = "Prevent" 
| count Name | top 5 Name by _count

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   dst

|where (signature_id >= 200 AND signature_id <= 299) OR (signature_id >= 300 AND signature_id <= 399) OR (signature_id >= 500 AND signature_id <= 899) OR signature_id = 10 OR (signature_id >= 1000000 AND signature_id <= 1999999)
| "Intrusion Prevention" as deepsecuritysource
| parse regex field=extension "act=(?<Action>.+?)\s\w+?=" nodrop
| if(action matches "IDS:*","Detect","Prevent") as action

|where if ("{{severity}}" = "*", true, severity matches "{{severity}}") AND if ("{{signature_id}}" = "*", true, signature_id matches "{{signature_id}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}")
|count _timeslice, action | transpose row _timeslice column action
